verdicts_or_reports.element: Folder list after paste with Rename
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Renamed copy of folder Alpha (e.g. Alpha (1)) appears in AndroidQA/Amaze with its contents
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After copying Alpha and pasting in the same folder, choosing RENAME in the conflict dialog creates no new folder. List still shows 2 folders and 4 files, even after leaving and re-entering. Reproduced twice.
steps: In the conflict dialog tap RENAME
Leave and re-enter the folder: no renamed copy exists

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Grid choice applies only to AndroidQA/Amaze; subfolder Alpha (never set) stays in list view
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After setting Grid View in AndroidQA/Amaze, opening its subfolder Alpha also shows grid. Parent AndroidQA and root remain list, so the setting leaks to child folders.
steps: Alpha shows grid; AndroidQA and root show list

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Grid applies only to the folder where it was chosen (AndroidQA/Amaze); subfolders Alpha and Beta stay in list view as they were never changed
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Fresh repro: Amaze set to Grid View. Opening Beta (and earlier Alpha) shows grid tiles without any toggle there. Parent AndroidQA and root show list. Subfolders inherit the parent's grid choice.
steps: Tap Beta (or Alpha) - shown as grid
Go Home and open AndroidQA - list view

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Bookmarks ordered by add time: Beta (added first) then Alpha (re-added later)
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Drawer lists Alpha above Beta even though Alpha was deleted and re-added after Beta (looks alphabetical)
steps: Add Alpha, then Beta to bookmarks via item menu
In drawer, tap Alpha bookmark's button > DELETE
Open drawer: Alpha is listed before Beta

sign_off.notes: One bug confirmed and logged: Rename in the paste conflict dialog creates no renamed folder copy. I filed two more that the developer could not reproduce. Per-folder view mode: Alpha and Beta showed grid after only Amaze was switched to grid. Bookmark order: Alpha was re-added after Beta but listed above it. Plain folder copy, file rename, sorting by size ascending and descending, and bookmark add, delete and open all behaved correctly. Not tested: rotation, Name/Date/Type sort, and "Only this folder" sort.
